text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph on pure white seamless background with soft neutral studio light. Entire items visible, realistic material texture, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin, hanger or stand, no text or watermark. A fitted black fine vertical rib-knit round-neck long-sleeve top with long cuffs, low-rise grey-black five-pocket jeans with heavily faded thigh fronts and slim straight legs, and a pair of black leather boots with elongated pointed toes with elongated slouchy folded shafts reaching just below the knees and small silver side studs. The jeans tuck into the boots. Matching black flat-top short-brim cap floats above the empty neckline; a narrow black leather belt with gold buckle is threaded through the jeans; a narrow black quilted gold-chain shoulder bag with tapered upper panel and gold interlocking-C clasp hangs at one side.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit image 1, the approved white-background invisible-body wardrobe product image. Images 2 and 3 are the original fashion reference, use them ONLY to correct the BLACK BOOTS' proportions. User correction: the boots are too short and stubby and need to look longer. Make both boot shafts visibly TALLER, extending upward about 30–35% compared with image1 so the broad slouchy folded-over upper shafts reach just below the knees and cover more of the existing jeans. Preserve ample soft leather folds and the silver studs along the OUTER sides of the folded panels. Lengthen the pointed toe and vamp moderately (about 12–15%) for a graceful elongated fashion boot silhouette; keep the modest narrow heel and black leather. Preserve the original leg/body silhouette and total outfit height: do NOT stretch the person-shaped arrangement or lengthen the jeans; replace more of the lower jeans area with the taller boots. Keep the pair proportional and symmetrical, display both entire elongated pointed toes with margin, no cropping. Preserve everything else in image1 exactly: top, rib knit, neckline, sleeves, denim wash, colors, lighting, pure white background, and every accessory that is present. Do not add or remove any accessory. No human, mannequin, body part, text or watermark. Output same portrait composition and high quality photorealistic product style.
reproduction_note: 依据用户两张参考照片制作白底无人商品图；被头发和靴子遮挡的服装区域保守补全。保留可见版型、纹理与配饰，不作为品牌或精确款号鉴定。
